--- usage
usage: kinds [options] --output PATH FILE [SECOND] [MORE...]
--- help
usage: kinds [options] --output PATH FILE [SECOND] [MORE...]

Read files and write their lines.

arguments:
  FILE               the file to read
  SECOND             a file to compare it with
  MORE...            more files

options:
  -v, --verbose      say more each time it is given
      --dry-run      change nothing
  -o, --output PATH  where to write
  -n, --lines N      how many lines (default: 10)
  -I, --include DIR  look in DIR too
      --colour WHEN  colour the output (default: auto)
  -h, --help         print this help
--- help for -o x a --help
usage: kinds [options] --output PATH FILE [SECOND] [MORE...]

arguments:

  MORE...            more files

options:

  -o, --output PATH  where to write
  -n, --lines N      how many lines (default: 10)

      --colour WHEN  colour the output (default: auto)
  -h, --help         print this help
--- help for --help
usage: sizes [options] [PATH...]

arguments:
  PATH...      what to measure

options:
  -h, --human  print sizes for people
      --help   print this help
--- help for -h
no help asked
--- help for -h
usage: vc [options] COMMAND

Keep versions.

options:
  -q, --quiet  say less
  -h, --help   print this help

commands:
  remote       Manage remotes.
  status       Say what changed.
--- help for remote --help
usage: vc remote [options] COMMAND

Manage remotes.

options:
  -h, --help  print this help

commands:
  add         Add a remote.
  remove      Remove a remote.
--- help for -q remote add -h
usage: vc remote add [options] NAME URL

Add a remote.

arguments:
  NAME         what to call it
  URL          where it is

options:
  -f, --force  replace a remote of that name
  -h, --help   print this help
--- help for status --help
usage: vc status [options]

Say what changed.

options:
  -h, --help  print this help
